text:
anya.s: Heads up — with the Lantern SI + CloudMart marketplace onboarding next week we need to finalize partner SEV/escalation flows. Can ppl sync on shared channel + war room ownership? :eyes:

matthew.k: Agree. Two scenarios I care about: Marketplace listing failures (billing/provisioning) and HW provisioning failures from Lantern. Separate runbooks?

sophia.r: We should reuse the 'partner-sev-playbook' but add a marketplace-specific section. Suggest shared channel naming: #partner-warroom-<partner>-<sev>. e.g. #partner-warroom-lantern-sev1

kevin_w: For oncall, ops owns infra-facing SEVs, partnerships owns partner comms. PD escalation policy: primary ops PD, if not ack in 5m escalate to infra lead, then partnerships lead. Recommend adding Lantern's support rep to a bilateral DM or shared channel.

marketplace-bot: Automated note: Onboarding checklist shows 'integration tests: failed' for Lantern marketplace entry. Link: https://go/redwood/marketplace/onboarding/lantern

anya.s: Thanks — can we define who spins the war room and who runs it. My thought: infra spins and tags @partnerships to manage partner comms + decision log.

matthew.k: Agree. Also need a template for the war room header with fields: SEV type, affected customers, PD incident link, partner contacts, runbook link, fallback model (hosted->dedicated). I'll paste a quick snippet: ```name: lantern-sev1
owner: infra-oncall
partners: lantern-svc-team@example.com
pd: pd.inc/1234
runbook: https://go/redwood/playbooks/partner-sev```

sophia.r: :thumbsup: I'll add that template to the partner runbook. Also propose a 3-wire escalation matrix: Slack shared channel, PagerDuty, and email for execs.

kevin_w: Who maintains the bilateral Slack channels with Lantern? Last time it was maintained by Partnerships SRE. cc @matthew.k

matthew.k: Partnerships ops (Anya) will create the shared channel + invite Lantern before go-live. Infra will add PD escalation rules.

anya.s: I'll create #partner-warroom-lantern-prelaunch now and invite Lantern + infra + marketplace team. Will drop the runbook and template once created.

oncall-bot: Reminder: If SEV1 declared, use `/warroom create --partner lantern --sev 1` to auto-create channel and PD incident. Docs: https://go/redwood/warroom-cli

sophia.r: Action items: Anya to create channel, Matt to update PD rules, Kevin to confirm Lantern contact email. We'll do a dry run tomorrow 09:30 PT. :calendar:

kevin_w: Lantern contact is support@lantern-inc.com and eng-lead@lantern-inc.com. I'll DM them to confirm availability for dry run.

anya.s: Perfect. If anyone wants to tweak the template ping me in the new channel. Closing here for now.
